<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Record the delivery of a stage — the review trigger.

```text
Closes a stage of the cycle by recording what was delivered in `changes/`.

The record has three parts, and the last two are what makes it useful:

  --intent      what you say you did (the DECLARED half of the confrontation)
  --decision    what the ruler did NOT decide and you chose alone
  --uncovered   what you KNOW is not proved

The last two may look optional and are not: a silent decision is the origin of most
of the defects that cross the gates (everything exists, everything references
everything, and someone chose alone). Declaring them is what separates assumed debt
from forgetting.

Example:

  anchors deliver --stage code --unit src/business-logic/pricing.ts \
    --file src/business-logic/pricing.ts --file src/business-logic/pricing.feature \
    --intent "implements PRICX-B01..B04; the carry-forward uses lexicographic comparison" \
    --decision "month outside YYYY-MM: I assumed valid input (the spec does not decide)" \
    --uncovered "PRICX-B04 has no scenario — the edge case depends on phase 2"

After this, the watcher queues the review task.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors deliver [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent` |  | who delivered (optional) |
| `--card` | `0` | github mode: the card to record on, instead of finding it by the unit's code (a plan card with no [CODE] in its title, or a change to generated files only) |
| `--date` |  | YYYY-MM-DD (REQUIRED — Anchors does not read the clock) |
| `--decision` |  | choice the ruler did not decide (repeatable) |
| `--file` |  | file touched (repeatable) |
| `--intent` |  | REQUIRED — what you claim to have done |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--stage` |  | REQUIRED — stage delivered: spec\|code\|feature\|test\|plan |
| `--uncovered` |  | what you know is not proven (repeatable) |
| `--unit` |  | REQUIRED — the file that identifies the unit of purpose |

## A fila de trabalho — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors next`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/next/) | Pull and claim the next item from the queue (the worker calls this) |
| [`anchors queue`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/queue/) | List live tasks (the work the watcher queued) |
| [`anchors work`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/work/) | Emit the work prompt of a stage (spec\|code\|feature\|test\|review) for a target |
| [`anchors done`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/done/) | Close claimed task(s) (moves to the .anchors/done/ history) |
| [`anchors drop`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/drop/) | Discard a task from the queue without completing it (removes; does not archive) |
| [`anchors reclaim`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/reclaim/) | Return to the queue the tasks stuck in claimed (dead worker) |
| **`anchors deliver`** | Record the delivery of a stage — the review trigger |
| [`anchors decided`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/decided/) | Release the card `escalate --for-user` stopped, once the decision is made |
| [`anchors discard`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/discard/) | Take off the board the card that no longer makes sense, without deleting it |
| [`anchors unblock`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/unblock/) | Open the work card that unblocks a card stuck in `needs-user` |
| [`anchors escalate`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/escalate/) | Open the issue for a change needed in the plan or the spec |
| [`anchors report-bug`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/report-bug/) | Report a bug in Anchors itself at github.com/co2-lab/anchors |
| [`anchors synthesize`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/synthesize/) | Two PRs conflicting in CONTENT become a synthesis card |
| [`anchors watch`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/watch/) | The background watcher: sees changes and QUEUES work |
| [`anchors monitor`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/monitor/) | Watch the project's long processes: one line when one starts, stalls, dies or ends |
| [`anchors flow`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/flow/) | Operate the work flows (the puzzle of actions and results) |
| [`anchors board`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/board/) | The project board — published by the pipeline, or served live |
